conclusion: The standard HexArith.Int.extGcd attachment is present but this build does not define LEAN_USE_GMP. Its object depends on Lean integer remainder, not mpz_gcdext. The measured switch uses the portable signed-integer C fallback and slows ECPP, so retain the established Nat implementation. Actual GMP branch enablement belongs to upstream build configuration and is not required by the ECPP arithmetic contract.
